description_en: Retrieves a list of service connections within a specified organization
description_zh: 可以获取服务连接列表
name: ListServiceConnections

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization's page in Alibaba Cloud DevOps: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service connection. Valid values:

- `aliyun_code`: Aliyun Code

- `Codeup`: Codeup

- `Gitee`: Gitee

- `github`: GitHub

- `ack`: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)

- `docker_register_aliyun`: Container Registry (ACR)

- `ecs`: ECS instance

- `edas`: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)

- `emas`: Enterprise Mobile Application Studio (EMAS)

- `fc`: Function Compute (FC)

- `kubernetes`: self-managed Kubernetes cluster

- `oss`: Object Storage Service (OSS)

- `PACKAGES`: artifact repository

- `ros`: Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)

- `sae`: Serverless App Engine (SAE)
parameters.help_zh:
服务连接类型

- aliyun_code 阿里云代码

-  Codeup Codeup

-  Gitee 码云

-  github Github 

- ack 容器服务Kubernetes（ACK）

-  docker_register_aliyun 容器镜像服务（ACR）

 - ecs ecs主机

-  edas 企业级分布式应用（EDAS） 

- emas 移动研发平台（EMAS）

-  fc 阿里云函数计算（FC）

-  oss 对象存储（OSS）

- PACKAGES 制品仓库

- sae Serverless应用引擎（SAE）
parameters.name: serice_connection_type
